question.text: A trader buys a Nifty call with strike 17,800 at premium Rs. 150. Nifty closes at 17,750 at expiry. What is the loss?

explanation.text: The Logic: Call Profit = max(S - X, 0) - Premium. Here S = 17,750 and X = 17,800. Since S is less than X, the call expires worthless and the loss equals the full Rs. 150 premium paid. Payoff = max(-50, 0) = 0; net P/L = 0 - 150 = -Rs. 150. The Trap: Rs. 50 wrongly uses the price gap as the loss; the OTM option is simply not exercised. Rs. 200 adds the gap to the premium. Rs. 0 ignores the fact that the buyer paid Rs. 150 up front and cannot recover it.
